reviews.text: Great for chats on all things!

I called once about a cat that was obviously very sick. They asked if we were customers which I said no to and they declined to see the cat unless we were customers. The cat died later that day on the way to a different vets who had agreed to see us but was further away.
Deirdre and her team have been looking after our pets for nearly 20 years now - couldn't recommend them highly enough.
Always trying to sell you something. Never helpful when asked any question about our dogs weight, food, neutering. Wouldn’t recommend.
